posts.zh:
dsh-Fonts 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b9bee0165ad296d49b70.html
posts.en:
dsh-Fonts is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b9bee0165ad296d49b70.html
